reviews.body: The product was delivered with open box installation without any issue. Booked the installation separately from Godrej. It was free of charge and installation has been done on the same day. The installation process was seamless and the technician explained everything well. I’ve been using this lock for more than a month and I don’t see any significant issue so far. The only problem is that the bell sound is almost inaudible and it is difficult to find.
